preconditions.description: The number of operators is between 1 and 100, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Each operator is either 'typedef A B' or 'typeof A'
preconditions.description: Each operator is either a type definition or a type retrieval.

preconditions.expression: A and B are non-empty lines of no more than 20 lowercase Latin letters
preconditions.description: The type names A and B are non-empty strings with a maximum length of 20 characters.

preconditions.expression: A does not contain asterisks or ampersands
preconditions.description: The type A does not contain any asterisks or ampersands.

preconditions.expression: B does not contain asterisks or ampersands
preconditions.description: The type B does not contain any asterisks or ampersands.

preconditions.expression: B is not void or errtype
preconditions.description: The type B is not void or errtype.

postconditions.expression: For every typeof operator, the output is the type that the given operator returned
postconditions.description: The output for each typeof operator is the type that the operator returned after all the typedef operators have been processed.

invariants.expression: All operators are processed in the order they are given
invariants.description: The order of processing operators is the same as the order in which they are given in the input.

invariants.expression: The type void is treated as void**...* with the necessary number of asterisks
invariants.description: The type void is treated as a pointer chain of voids, with the number of voids equal to the number of asterisks.

invariants.expression: The type errtype is treated as errtype* = &errtype = errtype
invariants.description: The type errtype is treated as a type that, when dereferenced or referenced, results in errtype.

invariants.expression: The pointer-definition operation has higher priority than the dereference operation
invariants.description: The operation &T* is always equal to T, regardless of the number of asterisks or ampersands in T.
